Dear colleagues,

We are recruiting a postdoctoral fellow in the Department of Computer and Information Science at the University of Pennsylvania, working on conversational AI for health and education.

The fellow will design, deploy, and evaluate AI role-play and feedback systems for students, frontline health workers, and clinicians,  with an initial focus on India.

We are especially interested in candidates who combine strong computational skills with experience in HCI, human–AI interaction, or implementation research, and enthusiasm for working with people and deploying systems in the field.

The position is based at Penn, with opportunities to collaborate with colleagues at Penn’s Center for the Advanced Study of India, Microsoft Research India, and NYU Stern. The fellow will have room to shape an independent research agenda and develop insights that extend across settings.
